correctness.rationale: Exact kernel monomial norms and weighted Cauchy–Schwarz establish an all-dimensional upper bound r/sqrt(1-r^2) for zero-constant contractive multipliers. The coordinate row contraction and von Neumann functional calculus make the directional degree-two Blaschke compositions contractive; exact multinomial expansion gives the lower profile ar/(1-ar), a=1/sqrt2. Both coincide at the sharp boundary; equality in Cauchy–Schwarz fixes every coefficient magnitude. Both profiles share derivative 2sqrt2 at contact, so the squeezed supremum has a uniform second-order remainder near the boundary. Infinite-coordinate sums converge by nonnegative monotone convergence. CHECK.py passes 102 finite diagnostic assertions but does not replace the proof.
